Last year I thought Threads was an existential risk to X. 

When Meta puts its full weight behind something -- by injecting the app into Instagram, it’s DEFCON 5:

You have to squeeze out every last drop of growth from all available surfaces to save the app.

However, I started to realize that the opposite was happening:

It was strengthening X.

If you look at any announcement by Zuck, you will see the most rude & toxic comments on the internet. 

But when he makes those same announcements on X, people are thrilled about how he’s pushing humanity forward. X is a place where people are excited about the future, so it’s no surprise he and his top lieutenants are using it more than their own app.

Threads — and Bluesky — have effectively quarantined some of the worst people on the internet. 

And so I had an epiphany: those apps are X’s anti-abuse systems.

Chamath says Anthropic should sacrifice valuation to raise at least $200 billion, because even that barely buys the compute needed to survive a correction

“Here’s my very specific thing about why I think they should price it to clear the market for $200 billion—and I’m specific about that number. They need, in my estimate, at least $200 billion. If you want to be super safe, a quarter-trillion gets the job done.

“What does the price need to be to attract that incremental dollar off the sidelines? Can they raise $80 billion in an IPO at $1.7, $1.8 or $1.9 trillion? I think so, handily. Can they raise $100 billion? Maybe it’s pushing it. At $150 billion, I think you need to be back down to $1.5 trillion.”

JCal: “You’re saying you want them to raise more money at a lower valuation so they have a war chest.”

Chamath: “$150 billion at $1.5 trillion is not enough. $200 billion barely gets them a few gigawatts. That is the bottom-line math if Anthropic is going to go through and survive an eventual correction.

“I think it’s much better for them to have $200 billion to $250 billion today than to try to ring the bell at $1.9 or $2 trillion for $80 billion, file a mixed shelf—which takes about six months—and hope the markets are in line.

“I just think there’s more risk in the future than there is today. Why take the risk? Price it to clear the market.”

Ben Horowitz reveals Amazon CEO Andy Jassy told him its AI compute is sold out beyond 2028, and says that shortage makes this fundamentally different from the dot-com bubble

“This shortage is so bad. You know, I was speaking with Andy Jassy, who runs Amazon, yesterday. And I said, yeah, like, we’re out of everything, you know, till 2028. He’s like, oh, it’s beyond 2028. Like, I don’t think we get stuff back, like, end of 2028, maybe. So everything else is sold out.”

“So he has the advantage of that, he’s got supply in a great shortage, which is extremely different than the internet bubble. The internet bubble, we didn’t have enough demand, because we had to build the internet, people had to get broadband, you know, you needed all this stuff people had to buy, you know, originally, they had to get their browser at price, all this kind of thing.”

“There weren’t enough consumers on the internet to absorb all the bandwidth that had gotten built out. And they had a massive amount of debt, not unlike we’re building today, although not as big. But the lack of demand killed it. We don’t really have a lack of demand in AI. So I think the dynamics will be different.”

“I do think, like, for sure, if you get into a pathological debt situation, that can wreck anybody. It’s why, by the way, we’re not invested in any of these neo-clouds either, for that reason.”

HTX过去一年销毁力度 平台币排名第二

过去一年里，各平台币都有不同的表现，我这里对比了BNB、HTX、GT、OKB、BGB五个平台币的销毁市值和流通市值，发现HTX的力度排名第二，仅次于GT。

很多人只看绝对金额，不看销毁 / 流通市值，其实这个比值也非常重要，从这里来看，HTX和BNB同档，甚至略高，绝对金额差BNB一大截 是市值体量差太多，但是含金量丝毫不差。

从季度销毁金额来看，Q2季度销毁了1360万，Q3季度销毁了1548万。因为HTX的销毁金额是平台营收的一半，所以证明HTX的Q3季度营收相较于Q2季度增长了13.82%。

HTX有没有提升和增长，看数据就行。
